title: Data Engineering — AI Learning Platform shared pathway
purpose: Micro-lesson plans, not written/reviewed educational lessons or working website modules

specialNotes: Polars listed as an option; faster than pandas or industry standard is workload-dependent, not asserted.
Exactly-once guarantees depend on connectors, sinks, and end-to-end design.
Advanced vendor choices are options, not mandatory sequential prerequisites.
